item.title: Truckies fed up over misuse of parking bays
item.description: Drivers are complaining that some companies are misusing rest bays as depots, conducting roadside repairs and disposing of oil and tyres. Image: Helen Keese Trouble is brewing between some Western Australian truckies over the widespread misuse of roadside parking bays around Kalgoorlie. These bays are important to manage fatigue for drivers but many complain that some companies are misusing rest bays as depots, conducting roadside repairs and disposing of oil and tyres on the side of the highway

item.title: WA truck parking bay being taken over by stockpiles of road material
item.description: Multiple piles of road metal are leaving little room for trucks to park at the Dumbleyung truck parking bay. Image: Wayne Imlay In Western Australia’s Wheatbelt region, the Dumbleyung truck parking bay has been filled with huge piles of road metal for several months. A veteran WA truck driver told Big Rigs that while the parking bay can usually accommodate 10-15 road trains, at the moment you’d be hard-pressed to fit four of them. item.title: Truckie charged over fatal level crossing crash has died
item.description: The ATSB released its preliminary report into the accident in 2024. Image: ATSB The veteran Queensland truckie accused of killing two train drivers in a Barrier Highway level crossing collision at the end of 2023 has died. Kevin Pearson, 77, had pleaded not guilty to two counts of causing death by dangerous driving over the South Australia incident which killed Kevin Baker and Mick Warren. item.description: Chris Greenwood with his venerable K125.
